mcp__pixellab__get_balance
declarations.description:
Check your account balance: remaining credits (USD) and subscription generations.

PixelLab AI-powered pixel art generation service.

Use of this service is subject to PixelLab's Terms of Service:
https://pixellab.ai/termsofservice

This MCP server provides programmatic access to generate:
- Characters with multiple directional views
- Character animations
- Isometric tiles
- Top-down tilesets for game maps
- Sidescroller tilesets for platformer games
- Music and sound effects for games

All generation operations are non-blocking and return job IDs for status tracking.
Requires PixelLab subscription (with credit fallback support).
A tool's full reference (every option, prices by size): search_help(tool="<tool name>"), free.

**Pixel tools (free, exact, you are the artist)**: one command line, pixelart_workbench(argv=[...]), inspects, edits, draws and animates pixel art by your own decisions; combine it with the AI tools above. Start with pixelart_workbench(argv=['describe', 'start'], mode='low'|'high') — low acts directly with few tokens, high plans out loud and reviews every frame. Animated effects (spells, hits, explosions, auras): vfx_workbench(argv=['describe', 'start']) — same ids, exports to the user's My effects.

**Git access**: Clone and push game project source code with standard git.
Use `list_projects` to see your projects and their git clone URLs.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__pixellab__get_balance(args: {}): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```

declarations.name: mcp__pixellab__get_image
declarations.description:
Get a raw-image result by job id, or a gallery image by `gallery:<id>`.

Returns the image(s) inline plus no-auth download URLs when completed, or
progress/error otherwise. A completed job also reports its gallery save:
the Creator ``asset_id`` once saved, or a failure note (the image is still
delivered) while the save is being retried.

declarations.name: mcp__pixellab__get_pro_flash_capabilities
declarations.description:

Free identity-only lookup. Supply operation, width and height together for
a provisional quote split into image/rotations/total. Finishing a selected
preview bills only rotations; one-direction object finalization costs zero.
Larger research sizes are not supported generation sizes. Read this before
selecting dimensions for image, character or object creation, edit or inpaint.

declarations.name: mcp__pixellab__get_upload_url
declarations.description:
Get a URL to upload a local image file to, without needing your API token.

Use it whenever you have an image on disk and a tool wants an image: send
the file with one curl, and pass the `upload:<id>` it returns to any
parameter that takes an image URL (image_urls, reference_image_url,
init_image_url, a style_image "url" ...). This avoids pasting base64 into a
tool call, which clients truncate and can corrupt. Free.

The URL works for 15 minutes and for any number of files. Uploads are kept
3 days. An animated GIF keeps all its frames.
